scope: Layered TOML config loader (Loader API surface) + workflow preference resolver and elevation proposer (Workflow Resolver surface). Formerly split as `config-design` (slice-1) and `config` (slice-2); merged into one concept.

entry_points.summary: [Loader API] Built-in default values for all config keys including [workflow] section (layer 1)
[Loader API] Allowed enum sets per dotted-key; hard-fail on repo/env, soft-warn on global
[Loader API] Build resolved config from all 4 layers; returns (values, sources) dicts
[Loader API] Resolve and print single dotted-key value; exits 3 on unknown or meta key
[Loader API] Print export lines for all user knobs; emit config_resolved event once per run
[Loader API] Write global config with defaults + inline comments if absent; never overwrites
[Loader API] Print effective value and source layer for one key
[Loader API] Print yes|no for a given event kind; always exits 0; exits 2 on unknown event
[Loader API] Thin bash wrapper: exec python3 scripts/config.py $@
[Workflow Resolver] Single source of truth for AskUserQuestion routing-class preference keys: workflow.audit_to_amend, workflow.slug_confirm; validated against VALIDATORS at module load
[Workflow Resolver] Module-load consistency check: asserts QUESTION_IDS <= VALIDATORS and RESULT_MAP references only valid choices; raises SystemExit(2) on violation
[Workflow Resolver] Consult 4-layer config + memory routing-preferences; return JSON {result, default, source, rule_id, strength, reason, sources[]}; stdout reserved for JSON
[Workflow Resolver] Walk docs/llm/*.json for routing-preference entries matching question_id; respects scope (global|project); skips INDEX.json and malformed entries
[Workflow Resolver] Merge memory match list: highest strength wins on agreement; returns (None, 'conflict', sources) when entries disagree
[Workflow Resolver] Atomically write a TOML key to global or project config via tmp+rename; validates against VALIDATORS before writing; exit 2 on invalid value
[Workflow Resolver] Print sorted JSON array of registered question IDs; consumed by /z-suggest-memory for routing-preference validation
[Workflow Resolver] Walk metrics.jsonl for repeated command-pair patterns; emit JSON proposal if threshold met; never writes — caller owns write

invariants: [Loader API] schema_version must equal 1 (else exit 2)
[Loader API] ensure-defaults never writes repo-local; only writes the global user path
[Loader API] should-notify always exits 0 on valid event kind (yes|no on stdout); exits 2 on unknown event
[Loader API] config_resolved event emitted at most once per $Z_HARNESS_RUN via O_EXCL temp-file de-dup
[Loader API] slice-1 enums: notify.level in {off, approval_only, all}; docs.always_apply in {always, never}
[Loader API] transliteration rule: dotted.key -> Z_HARNESS_<SECTION>_<KEY> (uppercase, dot to underscore)
[Loader API] keys must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; hyphens or >2-level nesting exit 2
[Loader API] empty env vars are treated as missing (not as override)
[Loader API] unknown keys in TOML files are silently ignored for forward compatibility
[Loader API] global-layer enum violations: soft-warn + fall back to default; repo/env-layer violations: exit 2
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.audit_to_amend valid values: ask | amend | stop; default ask
workflow.slug_confirm valid values: ask | auto_accept | recommend_derived; default ask
Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_AUDIT_TO_AMEND and Z_HARNESS_WORKFLOW_SLUG_CONFIRM are the env transliterations for the [workflow] keys
resolve-question stdout is reserved exclusively for JSON; all diagnostics route to stderr
Z_HARNESS_ASK_ALL=1 short-circuits resolve-question to always return {result: ask, source: override}
Z_HARNESS_EXPLAIN_RESOLUTION=1 or --explain flag prints a human-readable resolution trace on stderr
resolve-question exit 0 = valid JSON; exit 2 = bad invocation; exit 3 = unknown question_id (JSON with error key still emitted); exit 4 = I/O error (JSON still emitted)
QUESTION_IDS registry is the single source of truth; _run_startup_guards() asserts set(QUESTION_IDS) <= set(VALIDATORS) at module load
Resolver is read-only — never writes to config or memory; all writes go through config.py set or /z-suggest-memory
Conflict tier always returns result: ask; sources[] is always populated with both disagreeing entries
config.py set writes atomically via tmp+rename; validates against VALIDATORS before writing; exit 2 on invalid value
propose-prefs.py never writes automatically; proposal fires AskUserQuestion and user picks the write target
Proposer suppression is scoped to (project_root, question_id) stored in .z-harness/.propose-suppress; suppression expires after 30 days
Z_HARNESS_PROPOSE_WINDOW_S controls max gap (seconds) between command A end and B start for pattern detection; default 3600
Z_HARNESS_PROPOSE_THRESHOLD controls min repetitions to propose; default 3
Z_HARNESS_PROPOSE_MAX_RUNS controls number of recent run_start events to scan; default 30
routing-preference memory entries live in docs/llm/workflow.json (global scope) or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json (project scope)
gotchas: [Loader API] Global config validation is soft (warn + default fallback); repo/env config validation is hard (exit 2) — same bad value has different outcomes depending on which file it appears in
[Loader API] docs.always_apply=never only suppresses doc-fetcher in light flows (/z-do); heavy flows always dispatch doc-fetcher regardless
[Loader API] Z_HARNESS_REPO_CONFIG env var overrides git-root discovery entirely — exits 2 if path does not exist
[Loader API] ensure-defaults exits 4 (not 2) on I/O errors and when file exists but is empty or unparseable; it never silently overwrites
[Loader API] scripts/config.sh is only a 2-line exec wrapper — all logic lives in config.py
[Loader API] Empty env vars (Z_HARNESS_NOTIFY_LEVEL=) are treated as missing, not as overrides
[Workflow Resolver] workflow.slug_confirm value domain (ask/auto_accept/recommend_derived) is NOT the same as the resolver result domain (ask/prefill/skip); RESULT_MAP translates between them
auto_accept resolves to result: skip (silently accept derived slug); recommend_derived resolves to result: prefill (pre-select derived slug in AskUser)
Slug-confirm retrofit has TWO gates: hard collision check (always runs, resolver NOT consulted) + soft non-obvious confirmation (resolver-controlled). resolve-question only governs the soft gate
resolve-question error paths (exit 2/3/4) must always fall through to ask — never silently skip
Capture exit code separately from output: RESOLVED=$(python3 scripts/config.py resolve-question ...); RESOLVE_EXIT=$?. Do NOT pipe through set -e chains that swallow the exit code
When source==conflict, the AskUser surfaces a follow-up write-back question after the user picks, to prevent conflict from persisting across runs
Proposer in v1 only watches command-pair patterns (run_start/run_end in metrics.jsonl); it does NOT auto-propose workflow.slug_confirm because AskUser responses are not yet recorded in metrics.jsonl
Stale routing-preference memory after config supersedes it: v1 emits memory_potentially_superseded warning; cleanup is a v2 concern
Memory entries missing required fields are logged as routing_preference_malformed events and treated as non-existent (no crash)
Resolver falls back to git rev-parse --show-toplevel for project_root when Z_HARNESS_PROJECT_ROOT is unset; treats all memories as global if outside a git repo
_run_startup_guards() raises SystemExit(2) at module load on registry inconsistency — always add new question_ids to both QUESTION_IDS and VALIDATORS
Multi-IDE export (Cursor/Codex/agy) does NOT carry the precheck; those paths fall back to raw AskUserQuestion; v2 concern

workflow.audit_to_amend.description: Controls Phase 5 AskUserQuestion in /z-audit-plan and /z-audit-plan-style. ask=always prompt; amend=auto-proceed as amend (skips prompt); stop=auto-stop (skips prompt)

workflow.slug_confirm.description: Controls soft non-obvious-slug confirmation at 7 callsites. ask=always prompt; auto_accept=silently accept derived slug (resolver returns skip); recommend_derived=pre-select derived slug (resolver returns prefill). Collision check always runs unconditionally

routing_preference_memory_schema.description: Memory type for routing-class workflow preferences. Lives in docs/llm/workflow.json (global scope) or docs/llm/workflow-<project-slug>.json (project scope).

fields.question_id: <string — must be in QUESTION_IDS registry, e.g. workflow.audit_to_amend>
fields.project_root: <absolute path — required when scope is project; omit or null for global>

example.reason: Always amend after audit on this project

v2_deferrals: Stale-memory hygiene: when routing-preference memory exists and user later writes same question_id to config, v1 only warns (memory_potentially_superseded); v2 will add cleanup prompt or auto-archive
Async memory-write telemetry: propose_accepted event logged only after /z-suggest-memory returns 0
Multi-IDE export precheck integration: Cursor/Codex/agy fall back to raw AskUserQuestion in v1
Halt-class bypass (spec_problem, decision_needed): explicitly out of v1
